The original test has three `@MethodSource` provider methods (`arbitraryCodec`, `canonicalGetSpecifier`, `specifier`) that no test method references — they're dead code — plus several unused imports. Only `canonicalEncodings` feeds the single test. Let me write a cleaner version that preserves the exact runtime behavior.Compilation succeeded (`COMPILE_OK`). The improved test removes three unused `@MethodSource` providers and unused imports, groups the canonical-encoding table by codec "B" value with explanatory comments, names parameters meaningfully, and adds class-level documentation — all while calling `CodecEncoding.getCodec(value, null, null).toString()` with the exact same inputs and expected values as the original.
